title: EvolveNet: Collaborative Harness Evolution for Agent Self-Improvement
abstract: arXiv:2608.04968v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: An LLM agent can acquire persistent improvements by evolving its harness---the executable program governing model calls, tool use, verification, and recovery---without updating model weights. When the same harness serves users with different workloads, isolated evolution limits the sharing of useful discoveries, while centralized adaptation can introduce conflicting task-specific changes. We introduce EvolveNet, a framework for collaborative harness evolution that connects local specialization with shared capability accumulation. Clients evolve the same broadcast harness on their local workloads in parallel, and a server composes their adaptations into an updated shared program. Redistribution makes accepted discoveries available to all clients, allowing subsequent local evolution to build on improvements accumulated across the collaboration. translated_title: EvolveNet：面向智能体自我提升的协作式执行框架演化
translated_abstract: 大语言模型智能体可以通过演化其执行框架，即管理模型调用、工具使用、验证与恢复的可执行程序——而无需更新模型权重，从而获得持久的改进。当同一执行框架服务于具有不同工作负载的用户时，孤立演化会限制有用发现的共享，而集中式适配则可能引入相互冲突的任务特定修改。我们提出了 EvolveNet，一个将本地特化与共享能力积累相连接的协作式执行框架演化框架。客户端在各自的本地工作负载上并行演化同一广播的执行框架，服务器则将它们的适配组合成更新后的共享程序。重新分发使被接受的发现对所有客户端可用，使后续的本地演化能够建立在跨协作积累的改进之上。EvolveNet 通过证据引导的、按作用域分类的程序聚合以及……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出 EvolveNet 框架，通过客户端并行演化同一执行框架、服务器聚合各客户端适配并重新分发的协作机制，在不更新模型权重的情况下实现智能体的持续自我改进与跨用户能力积累。
en_tdlr: EvolveNet enables agent self-improvement through collaborative harness evolution, where clients evolve a shared harness in parallel on their local workloads and a server aggregates and redistributes their adaptations to accumulate capabilities across users without updating model weights.
